scholarships.title: INSEAD Scholarships (Master in Management, MBA and Master in Finance)

eligibility: Admitted to the INSEAD Master in Management (MIM) programme for automatic consideration for the Diversity and Achievement Scholarships
The Kung Family Scholarship: exceptional female candidates admitted to the MIM programme who can substantiate financial need, open to candidates admitted in Rounds 1-3

The L'Oréal for Youth Scholarship: a candidate of any nationality who demonstrates personal achievements and capacity for creativity and innovation through diversity, open to candidates admitted in Rounds 1-2
The MIM Women's Merit Scholarship: exceptional women candidates demonstrating outstanding academic excellence, leadership potential and personal achievements
The Qinqin and Xin Zhang Scholarship: a candidate who demonstrates academic and personal achievements and justifies financial need, open to candidates admitted in Rounds 1-3
existing.eligibility_summary: Candidates who have been admitted to the programme are automatically reviewed for the Diversity and Achievement Scholarships. A small number of named scholarships require a separate application and have their own eligibility criteria, including gender, financial need and admission round.
benefits: Average MIM scholarship amount published by INSEAD: €14,500
Automatic consideration for the Diversity Scholarship and the Achievement Scholarship
Named donor scholarships requiring a dedicated application
Tuition fees for the Class of MIM 2028 are €57,870, so the average award covers roughly a quarter of tuition
requirements: Start the MIM application first — 'To apply for a scholarship, or to be automatically considered for one, you must first start your MIM application'
Submit accurate details of your financial situation
For named scholarships, submit the dedicated application
documents: INSEAD programme application, which must be started before any scholarship can be considered
Accurate details of your financial situation
Programme-specific additional documentation for named scholarships that require a dedicated application
application_method: Automatic consideration: no separate form for the Diversity Scholarship and the Achievement Scholarship; award notification arrives by email after the admission decision
Separate application required for the named scholarships (Kung Family, L'Oréal for Youth, MIM Women's Merit, Qinqin and Xin Zhang)
existing.selection_notes: Diversity Scholarships are granted to candidates who bring diversity to the class in terms of background, work experience and personal profiles. The Achievement Scholarship focuses on excellence in academics and personal achievements.
existing.best_fit: Admitted candidates to INSEAD's Master in Management, MBA or Master in Finance who need help with tuition fees, either through automatic merit consideration or through a named donor scholarship with its own criteria.
existing.notes: The stored official_source_url is INSEAD's 'International Funding' page for the MBA, which lists third-party loans and scholarships (Lendwise, Prodigy Finance, MBA for Women, Educations.com, CFA Institute) rather than INSEAD's own awards. INSEAD's own awards are published on the per-programme 'INSEAD Scholarships' pages, which is where the Diversity, Achievement, Kung Family, L'Oréal for Youth, MIM Women's Merit and Qinqin and Xin Zhang scholarships are described.
existing.duration: One admission cycle, aligned to the MIM, MBA or MIF programme the candidate is admitted to.
existing.application_period: Aligned to the INSEAD admissions rounds for each programme; MIM is a multi-campus (France and Singapore) August intake.
existing.deadline_display: There is no separate scholarship deadline: to be considered for a scholarship you must first start the MIM application. The named scholarships are open to candidates admitted in specific admission rounds (Kung Family and Qinqin and Xin Zhang: Rounds 1-3; L'Oréal for Youth: Rounds 1-2).
existing.program_type: Merit and need-based tuition scholarships awarded to admitted INSEAD Master's and MBA candidates

scholarships.title: ENS de Lyon Scholarships of Excellence (Ampère and GRADUATE +)

eligibility: Admitted to an ENS de Lyon Master's programme open to international students (Ampère)
Admitted to a Master's degree within the CORE, DynLifeSys, MathInfi or PACE Graduate initiatives, at M1 or M2 level (GRADUATE +)
L3 degree (Bachelor, 180 ECTS) or equivalent for entry to M1
M1 degree (240 ECTS) or equivalent for entry to M2
For the GRADUATE + PACE initiative, M2 applicants only
Non-European students must not hold the nationality of an EEA country, Switzerland, Monaco or Andorra, and must have obtained a higher-education degree in a foreign country
Applications are approved by the admission committee
existing.eligibility_summary: International students applying to an ENS de Lyon Master's programme open to international students, with an L3 (180 ECTS) for M1 or an M1 (240 ECTS) for M2, selected on academic merit by the ENS de Lyon admission committee. Non-European students must both hold a non-EEA nationality and hold a higher-education degree obtained abroad.
benefits: Ampère Merit Scholarship: €1,000 per month for 12 months, renewable under conditions
GRADUATE + Scholarship: €1,000 per month for 10 months
One online application form for both a Master's programme and a scholarship of excellence
requirements: Use the correct online application form: 'Application on the wrong form will not be considered'
Submit before the deadline: 'Applications submitted after the deadline will not be considered'
Do not apply by email: 'Applications submitted via email will not be considered'
Upload every requested document: 'Incomplete applications will not be considered'
documents: Certificate of diplomas and degrees already obtained, in French or English
University academic transcript of records, in French or English
For the current year: proof of enrollment
Programme-specific documents such as research projects, language certificates or letters of recommendation
application_method: One online form covers both the Master's programme application and the scholarship of excellence
Three separate forms for ENS de Lyon: European student, non-European student with a foreign higher-education degree, and non-European student with a French higher-education degree
Separate forms for Graduate+ applications to programmes not provided by ENS de Lyon (Université Claude Bernard Lyon 1, Université Jean Monnet)
existing.selection_notes: All applications are reviewed by the admission committee of ENS de Lyon. No results are given by phone. Successful candidates receive a letter of pre-enrolment.
existing.best_fit: High-achieving international applicants to ENS de Lyon Master's programmes in Exact Sciences, Arts, and Human and Social Sciences, or to a CORE, DynLifeSys, MathInfi or PACE graduate initiative.
existing.notes: The stored record named this scholarship 'AMIDEEX', which is not the name used by ENS de Lyon; the official page names the Ampère Merit Scholarships and the GRADUATE + Scholarship. ENGLISH correction: the stored title's AMIDEEX attribution is a provenance error. GRADUATE + scholarships are funded within the framework of the French government's SFRI programme. US, Canadian and Indian nationals enrolled at a university in their own country may additionally apply for the Lafayette Fellowship or a French embassy scholarship, which are separate schemes.
existing.duration: Ampère: 12 months (renewable under conditions). GRADUATE +: 10 months (renewable in M2 for a further 10 months subject to selection and validation of Year 1).
existing.application_period: Annual single-round call, opening in November and closing in late January for the following academic year. The next calendar will be published in November 2026.
existing.deadline_display: Call for application 2026-2027 is now closed. Deadline for submission was January 23, 2026 at 11:59pm (CET), with applications opening on November 14, 2025 and results in mid-March 2026. The calendar for 2027-2028 will be updated in November 2026.
existing.program_type: Monthly merit-based stipend for international students entering an ENS de Lyon Master's programme
